item.title: Game Boy Emulator
item.description: A Game Boy (DMG) emulator written in C++, built from scratch to understand the CPU, memory system, graphics, and interrupts.

item.title: 6502 Emulator
item.description: A cycle-counted NMOS 6502 emulator with memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, and a real ca65/ld65 assembler toolchain. Passes the Klaus Dormann functional test suite.
